title: Cryogenic propellant transfer | Independent 2D CFD concept
author: Mohammadreza Khani, PhD; Khani Solutions
scope: Independent New Glenn-inspired public-reference concept; not New Glenn tank CAD, employer hardware, manufacturer analysis or a flight prediction.

model.dimensions: Planar 2D section with one cell through 0.1 m thickness and empty front/back boundaries
model.geometry_provenance: Inherited generic tank section previously used in a Falcon 9 reference visualization; not New Glenn tank CAD
model.receiver_coupling: Separate one-way boundary-forced receiver; pipes, pumps and two-way pressure coupling unresolved

observations.pressure_span_definition: Maximum minus minimum pressure on saved shell boundary, relative fluid-load quantity; not absolute ullage pressure or structural stress

interpretation.bubble_morphology: Coarse non-equilibrium VOF observation; not resolved 3D area or equilibrium bubble prediction
interpretation.pressure_video_map: Frame-relative cell pressure on a fixed 0–80 kPa scale; shell-boundary numeric span is separately labeled
interpretation.collapse_factor: No numerical collapse factor; flow histories and planar interface/wetting proxies may inform future coupled thermal/compressible analysis
interpretation.structural_analysis: No stress, strength or buckling calculation; future load mapping and structural model required
interpretation.whole_tank_orbital_transfer_and_earth_re: Hypothetical extension, not a demonstrated New Glenn operation

qualification.numerical_scope: Tank-wise inventory, boundedness and guard checks assessed; measured receiver-coupling mismatch retained

presentation.temporal_and_spatial_interpolation: Presentation only; no CFD rerun or field editing for cinematic effect
presentation.branded_derivative: Separate derivative adds a Khani Solutions / khanisolutions.com footer to the original film and cover. Original sequence, duration, simulation images and audio are preserved; original delivery is retained separately.

source_context.credit: Blue Origin; distributed through NASA Goddard SVS
